title: Classification of cognitive ability of healthy older individuals using resting-state functional connectivity magnetic resonance imaging and an extreme learning machine.
summary: An extreme learning machine on resting-state functional-connectivity features classified excellent versus poor cognitive-test performance in healthy older adults with mean accuracy 86.67%, relative to conventional correlation analysis. This is retrospective cohort classification and does not establish early disease diagnosis. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
